highlight.zh: KLCI收1582.59点，跌0.21%；财政部研究扩大i-Sayang，或让大马丈夫为外籍妻子缴公积金，尚未定案；刘镇东称MediAsas为自愿保险，非自动全民保障。
highlight.en: Today's key points: KLCI closed at 1,582.59, down 0.21%. The Finance Ministry is studying expanding i-Sayang so Malaysian husbands may contribute EPF for foreign wives; no decision yet. Lau Chin Tong says MediAsas is voluntary insurance, not automatic universal coverage.
